sources.title: llm-model-tracker/deepseek-v4-flash.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: DeepSeek V4 Flash scores 72.2 coding average (benchlm.ai) — roughly 85-90% of GLM-5.2's coding quality at 1/10th the API cost ($0.09+$0.18/M vs $0.91+$2.86/M). Strong on logical reasoning and coding. Weaker on agentic tasks (55.4 vs GLM-5.2's higher scores). For cost-conscious workflows, this is the best value frontier-tier model available. The 1M context window matches GLM-5.2.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4: How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Built for coding, agentic, and chat workflows with a 1M context window, this guide shows how to run DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 locally using Unsloth Dynamic GGUFs and Unsloth Desktop. For lossless DeepSeek, use Q8 (UD-Q8_K_XL), which is only 7GB larger than Q4 (UD-Q4_K_XL).
